translated_title: Mexico's Fertilizers for Well-Being Reaches 89% of Its 2026 Goal; More Than 1,920,000 Producers Benefited
original_title: Fertilizantes del Bienestar llega al 89% de su meta de 2026; beneficiados más de un millón 920 mil productores
author: Jared Laureles and Alexia Villaseñor
meta_description: By early July the program had moved nearly 970,000 tons of fertilizer through 1,033 centers, with Coahuila the first state to reach 100% of its registered farmers.
